lines.title: AI & Digital Solutions
lines.tagline: Smarter digital solutions. More efficient business.
lines.what: I design and build websites and business applications, and I build AI agents and automations that connect systems, teams, and data. From CRM development and ERP integration to sales, marketing, and operations automation, I deliver practical digital solutions shaped around each project's needs.
lines.who: Companies and teams that need a website or system serving a clear business process, or that lose time to repetitive tasks and data scattered across tools.
deliverables: Problem definition, scope, and first-release priorities
Website or app build with the required functionality
CRM or ERP connected to your team's tools and data
AI agents and workflows with clear limits on what stays a human decision
lines.notIncluded: Hosting and domain, model and tool subscriptions, CRM/ERP licenses, paid assets, copywriting, translation, and photography are priced separately.

privacyPage.metaDescription: What the project form collects, why, how long it is kept, and how to request deletion.
privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.intro: A short, plain page: exactly what I collect, why, and how long I keep it.

sections.title: What I collect
sections.body: Only what you type into the "Start a project" form: your name, company if you add it, email, WhatsApp number if you add it, the service line and package, budget range, timeline, project description, and any links you send. I also record the page language and the source of your visit (for example a campaign or an external link) so I know where the brief came from. I also ask how you heard about me. When you tap the WhatsApp button, I record only the page you tapped it on and where the visit came from, with no name or number.

sections.title: Why I collect it
sections.body: Only to respond to your request: reviewing the brief, contacting you, and preparing a written proposal. No newsletters, no marketing messages.

sections.title: How long I keep it
sections.body: Briefs are kept for 12 months from the date they are sent, then deleted. If we work together, contract records are kept for as long as the law requires.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can request a copy of your data, a correction, or deletion at any time by emailing the address below. I act on the request within a reasonable time.

sections.title: No selling, no sharing
sections.body: Your data is never sold or shared with anyone else. Only the technical services needed to run the site and send me the notification are involved.

sections.title: Analytics and spam protection
sections.body: Visits are counted with Umami, a privacy-focused tool that sets no cookies and stores no personal data, so there is nothing to accept. The form is protected by Cloudflare Turnstile, which checks that a person, not a bot, is sending it.

sections.title: Where your data is stored and who processes it
sections.body: Your data controller is Mohammed Alagab, who runs moalagab.art. Briefs are stored in a Supabase database in Germany (Frankfurt). The site is hosted on Vercel and brief notifications reach me through Resend, both in the United States, and Cloudflare checks the form to block automated submissions. This means your data is transferred outside Saudi Arabia, for these purposes only. For any question or request about your data, email me at the address below.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: Briefs are stored in a protected database that no visitor can read. Access is mine only.

aboutPage.metaTitle: About Mohammed Alagab — Design × Operations × Applied AI
aboutPage.metaDescription: From building identities to building systems: Mohammed Alagab’s path through design, operations and applied AI. Over 12 years across Sudan, Oman and Saudi Arabia.
aboutPage.name: Mohammed Alagab
story: I began where people see the work: the brand, the image and the experience.
Over more than 12 years across Sudan, Oman and Saudi Arabia, I worked in branding, art direction, exhibitions and brand activation, then gradually moved into operations and project delivery.

I built more than 40 identity systems for organisations across sectors, working with teams, suppliers and decision-makers on projects spanning identity and advertising through to exhibitions and on-site experiences.

principles.title: Evidence before claims
principles.body:
I do not build my reputation on what I say I can do.
I show what I have built, tested and achieved, and clearly distinguish what has worked in practice from what is still experimental.

principles.title: The system matters more than the piece
principles.body:
Identity, product, workflow and AI are connected parts.
Their value emerges when they work together as one system.

principles.title: Automation for repetition. People for judgment.
principles.body:
I let machines handle what repeats and can be controlled.
Decisions that need context and human judgment stay with people.

principles.title: Clarity before execution
principles.body: Before any project begins, these questions must have clear answers:
questions: How will we know we are done?

principles.title: Build before theorising
principles.body:
The best way to understand a system is to build and run it.
I prefer a working prototype, a real workflow or a product you can try over ten pages of theory.

timeline.title: The beginning — Sudan
timeline.body: I started in advertising and design, learning to turn ideas into real outputs while working within time, budget and client requirements.

timeline.title: Oman
timeline.body: Working in the Omani market, I began treating a brand as a system that extends beyond its logo into campaigns, marketing materials and different touchpoints.

timeline.title: Saudi Arabia
timeline.body:
I moved from executing design to leading creative work.
Brand strategy, visual identity, campaigns, production, and managing teams and suppliers from idea to delivery.

timeline.title: Al Khafji Joint Operations — KJO / Aramco
timeline.body:
The work expanded into a wider operational environment.
Projects, exhibitions, wayfinding, stakeholders, suppliers and deadlines: the quality of the outcome depended on how well the system worked, as well as the design itself.

timeline.title: First Value
timeline.body:
I brought together brand strategy, creative leadership and managing work from idea to execution.
The focus moved toward building a clear brand direction and connecting it to the business and its outputs.

timeline.title: Independent Practice
timeline.body:
I shifted more clearly from producing outputs to building the systems that produce them.
Operations, projects, workflows, digital products and automation tied to real business problems.

timeline.title: Operational Clarity
timeline.body:
Today, I work at the intersection of operations, AI and product building.
I build workflows, AI agents and digital products, turning real business problems into systems that can be operated and measured.
Current projects include Smart Field and LifeTent: the first demonstrates automation within a real sales process; the second is my experience of building an Arabic product from scratch.

aboutPage.heroStatement: I design what people see, and build the system that makes the work happen behind it.
aboutPage.storyTitle: From building identities to building systems
aboutPage.storyObservation: Over time, I started to notice a recurring pattern:
storyQuote: The problem is rarely the idea.
It is the system that turns the idea into a result.
newQuestions: What happens after it leaves my hands?
storyBridge: That shift led me further into operations, digital products, automation and AI.
I started building working websites and products, then workflows, CRM systems and AI agents connected to real data and business problems.
aboutPage.impactLabel: Sales opportunities processed by the automation system
aboutPage.impactTitle: When automation becomes part of the work.
aboutPage.impactBody: In one project, I built a sales automation system that processed more than 1,100 opportunities using CRM, AI agents and n8n, turning automation from a technical idea into a working part of the sales process.
storyToday: Today, I see design, operations and AI as connected disciplines.
I design what people see, and build the system that makes the work happen behind it.
aboutPage.storyFlowLabel: This is where I work from today
closingBody: An idea needs a system that makes it work.
That system needs someone who understands the bigger picture and the details beneath it.
aboutPage.closingLine: From vision to systems that work.
